title: Sandwich Steps
statement:
A very literal robot makes a sandwich only if you give clear steps in order.
Write a function that takes a list of step strings and returns them joined with " -> " so the robot can read the plan.
Example: ["take bread", "add chutney", "close"] → "take bread -> add chutney -> close".
If the list is empty, return an empty string.
hints: Walk the list from start to end. Do not skip or reorder.
Join the steps with the exact separator " -> ".
An empty list means there is nothing to join.

solution.approach: Join every step string with " -> ". Most languages have a built-in join for this.
solution.complexity: A few steps for a short list — grow with the number of instructions.

analogy: writing a sandwich recipe for a literal robot
